key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Gosh Is Launcher. Default is Ctrl+Space.

key.name: launcher-theme
key.description: Visual style of the launcher popup.

key.name: popup-position
key.description: Where the launcher sits on the primary monitor.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the launcher popup in pixels.

key.name: results-max-height
key.description: Maximum height of the results list before scrolling.

key.name: max-results
key.description: Maximum results displayed per category.

key.name: result-order
key.description: default keeps apps before windows. windows-first matches the Pop!_OS launcher.

key.name: row-density
key.description: Spacing of result rows.

key.name: show-search-icon
key.description: Show the magnifying-glass icon in the search entry.

key.name: show-section-headers
key.description: Show category labels above groups of results.

key.name: show-result-icons
key.description: Show icons on result rows.

key.name: show-descriptions
key.description: Show secondary text under result titles.

key.name: show-result-numbers
key.description: Show 1-9 hints and activate with Alt+digit.

key.name: show-empty-suggestions
key.description: When the query is empty, show open windows and frequent apps.

key.name: enable-prefix-modes
key.description: Allow = @ # $ . ! prefixes to jump to a single provider.

key.name: enable-app-search
key.description: Search installed applications.

key.name: enable-app-actions
key.description: Show New Window and desktop-file actions for the best app match.

key.name: enable-calculator
key.description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions.

key.name: enable-unit-convert
key.description: Convert length, mass, temperature, volume, and data sizes such as 10 km to mi.

key.name: enable-window-search
key.description: Search and switch to open windows.

key.name: enable-system-actions
key.description: Show lock, suspend, restart, and related actions.

key.name: enable-settings-search
key.description: Search GNOME Settings panels.

key.name: enable-recent-files
key.description: Search recently opened files.

key.name: enable-url-open
key.description: Open typed URLs and domain names in the browser.

key.name: enable-places
key.description: Search XDG user folders such as Documents and Downloads.

key.name: enable-time-date
key.description: Show the local time or date when the query is time, date, now, or today.

key.name: enable-path-open
key.description: Open typed ~/ ./ and absolute filesystem paths.

key.name: enable-command-run
key.description: Run a shell command when the query uses the ! prefix.

key.name: web-search-engine
key.description: Search engine used for the web search fallback.

key.name: show-web-search
key.description: If true, a web search result is shown when nothing else matches.
